```plato

    // The cosine of the angle between a and b: Dot divided by the product of
    // magnitudes. Preconditions: a and b are non-zero.
    CosineSimilarity(a: IVector, b: IVector): Number
        => a.Dot(b) / (a.Magnitude * b.Magnitude);
```
